status: Repeated per-pixel draw-context preparation is closed: counted 2706→1 regression, seven lifetime cases, full four-context/package/original qualification and exact native outputs. Quiet chart improvements are bounded; icon/control throughput is near neutral.
correction: Prepare immutable shader scope/alpha once within image, texture rectangle, linear/radial rectangle and glyph draws. Existing polygon samplers already capture their draw context. Gradient coordinates and dithering share one per-pixel origin; all sampling equations, float operations, clip/source/grid-origin rules and cancellation checkpoints remain unchanged. No global cache or new storage owner.
callerReview: Embedded image: use captured source origin directly when present; otherwise borrow current draw context. Mipmap preparation and coverage admission are unchanged.
Texture rectangle: freeze current alpha and context before traversal. Static pattern helper receives explicit immutable context/alpha; original pixel sampling order remains.
Linear/radial rectangle: freeze after stop/ramp preparation and early admission checks; each pixel queries its own grid/clip origin and keeps all coordinate fallback arithmetic.

Glyph: borrow current context only for nonconstant shaders needing coordinates; solid and constant factories keep no sampling context. Pixel callbacks do not change frame/layer/map/paint scope. Alpha keeps the original pattern/color multiplication.
Polygon/hairline samplers: retain existing per-draw descriptor; only share each sample origin between coordinate and dither stages. Clip-bound lookup is read-only.
fixtureCorrection: The new glyph counter fixture uses a 1000-unit font size and user-space gradients to expose its tiny synthetic outline. Earlier empty-fixture attempts remain private diagnostic logs; no frozen image or expected rendering value changed.
